name: openmotion-design
description: Create, revise, version, annotate, import and export HTML Design Studio projects (interactive web/app prototypes, 16:9 slide decks with speaker notes, print-ready documents, website clones, data-backed live artifacts and WebGL2 experiences) through openmotion_design_catalog, openmotion_design_project, openmotion_design_edit and openmotion_design_comments. OpenMotion runs no internal design agent: external Agents author and iterate over MCP while Design Studio previews, annotates and exports.
